components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Primary CTA — brand-green pill with cream text.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); color:var(--dr-diet-bg-color,#F8F4EC); font:500 14px/1.4 'Inter',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.1px; padding:12px 28px; border:none; border-radius:9999px; cursor:pointer; transition:filter 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { filter:brightness(0.85); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Dark Button
components.description: Secondary CTA — green outline on cream, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); font:500 14px/1.4 'Inter',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.1px; padding:12px 28px; border:1.5px solid var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); border-radius:9999px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); color:var(--dr-diet-bg-color,#F8F4EC); }

components.name: Order Pill
components.description: Per-dish order link on meal cards — white pill, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-order-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#fff; color:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); font:500 14px/1.4 'Inter',sans-serif; padding:10px 20px; border:1px solid var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); border-radius:9999px; text-decoration:none; transition:background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-order-pill:hover { background:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); color:var(--dr-diet-bg-color,#F8F4EC); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Menu/location filter pill; active inverts to green fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { background:transparent; color:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); font:600 0.88rem/1 'Inter',sans-serif; padding:9px 22px; border:1.5px solid var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); border-radius:9999px; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.3s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background:rgba(65,76,60,0.08); } .ds-chip--active { background:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); color:#fff; }

components.name: Meal Card
components.description: Dish card — white, flat at rest, green border + shadow on hover.
components.html:
Artisan Stuffed Chicken Breast

Tender chicken breast stuffed and oven-baked.
components.css: .ds-meal-card { background:#fff; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:12px; padding:24px; transition:border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-meal-card:hover { border-color:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-meal-card__img { aspect-ratio:1/1; border-radius:8px; background:#DACAA9; margin-bottom:24px; } .ds-meal-card h3 { font:400 24px/1.25 'Bethany Elingston',cursive; color:var(--primary-dr-diet-color,#414C3C); margin:0 0 12px; } .ds-meal-card p { font:400 16px/1.5 'Inter',sans-serif; color:#646464; margin:0; }

narrative.overview: Dr Diet looks like the brand feels: warm, hand-made, and honest. The whole world sits on two colours — a deep olive brand green and a warm cream — with a single lime-yellow accent kept for backgrounds only. Headlines are set in a flowing handwritten script, as if chalked on a kitchen board, while everything functional is clean Inter. Food photography does the selling: real dishes on a dark slate, shot close. The green is the single ink colour on cream; hierarchy comes from the script-vs-sans contrast, size, and weight, not from more hues. Depth is soft and state-driven — faint shadows that lift a card on hover, never a hard edge or a neon glow. This is a Persuade surface: ambition shows as appetite and trust, not spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Two-colour world (olive green + cream) with lime accent reserved for fills.
Handwritten script display face against clean Inter body.
Real, close food photography on dark slate — never stock clichés.
Soft, state-driven depth; rounded, friendly forms.
One or two authored motion moments per page; everything else is quiet.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: On any surface there is exactly one text colour: brand green on light, cream on dark. Secondary text is tinted from the surface, never a generic grey and never a second brand hue.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-A-Fill Rule
rules.body: Lime #E2E573 is a background, not an ink. If tempted to colour text or an icon lime, use weight or size instead.

rules.name: The Script-For-Voice Rule
rules.body: Script is for headings and card titles only. Used for body, a label, or a button it stops being special and becomes unreadable.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards sit flat on their ground and gain shadow only on hover/focus/open. Depth narrates interaction; it is never decoration at rest.

dos: Do keep one ink per surface: brand green on light, cream on dark. Tint secondary text from the surface.
Do set every heading and card title in the script face, and everything functional in Inter.
Do use real, close food photography on dark slate; pull dish names, protein, and price from the menu PDF.
Do reserve lime #E2E573 for background fills (CTA, bands) only.
Do keep cards flat at rest and let shadow respond to hover/focus (sm to md).
Do use pills for all buttons, tags, and filters; hairline stroke-colour borders.
donts: Don't introduce a third brand colour, gradient text, or a grey secondary text colour.
Don't set body copy, labels, or buttons in the script face.
Don't use stock 'healthy lifestyle' photography, invented testimonials, press, or transformation before/afters.
Don't add hard offset shadows, coloured halos, or thick coloured border-left accents.
Don't claim outlet/city counts other than the real 17 outlets / 6 cities.
